visual_review: All 128 sampled frames reviewed in four contact sheets, with suspicious frames and the focused before/after reproduction inspected at full size. Does not cover every animation frame.

confirmed_bugs.name: Camera drag ends as measurement selection click
confirmed_bugs.root: onClickFallback suppresses edit drags through wasDragging, but does not suppress clicks produced by measure-mode camera rotations.
confirmed_bugs.focused_regression: measurement-rotation-click.spec.cjs intentionally marks current behavior as an expected failure; the test runner reports a pass because the known incorrect behavior was reproduced.

confirmed_bugs.name: Duplicate atom index and measurement number
confirmed_bugs.root: Ordinary atom labels remain visible when colored selected-point markers are displaced to avoid overlaps.

framing_observation: Find atom by number recenters the pivot on each selected atom without refitting the whole structure; later rotations can move other atoms outside the viewport. This is distinct from depth-clipping disappearance and not classified as a new confirmed renderer bug.
not_reproduced_in_sampled_frames: whole viewport blank after sidebar resize
initial_run: Two molecule chains completed; two crystal chains stopped after rotation changed the measurement selection and the existing three-point helper failed. The continuation records selection changes and restores the measurement so later combinations can be exercised.
